summary: Repository-local prose configuration is a good indirection point; setup must target the active harness, verify capabilities honestly, and preserve existing decisions.

supporting_disposition.reason: Keep GitHub conventions and relationship distinctions; verify available CLI/API capabilities rather than ship known unsupported fields.
Keep issue/MR distinction, notes-before-close, and capability-dependent blocking.
Provide a new-tracker seed while explicitly giving the observed existing tracker schema priority, including single-file trackers.
Include category roles as well as state mapping and record whether remote labels actually exist.
Preserve lazy creation, multi-context routing, domain vocabulary, and explicit ADR-conflict rules.
Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy exactly.
Retain Matt Pocock MIT attribution in every refactored package.

deltas.change: Write pointers into the instruction file the active harness actually consumes.
deltas.reason: Preferring CLAUDE.md merely because it exists can hide configuration from Codex.
deltas.tradeoff: Mixed-harness repos need one deliberate canonical pointer decision.

deltas.change: Treat label mapping and existing remote labels as different facts.
deltas.reason: Writing a vocabulary table does not provision the tracker.
deltas.tradeoff: Setup can end with a precise pending external step.

deltas.change: Cover all known downstream label consumers, not triage discovery alone.
deltas.reason: to-tickets applies ready-for-agent even if triage is not installed.

deltas.change: Verify command capability read-only and distinguish parent links from blocking links.
deltas.reason: Source templates contain a documented unsupported JSON field and relationship ambiguity.
deltas.tradeoff: Templates are capability instructions rather than timeless command recipes.

deltas.change: Honor natural-language verify-only requests within the same skill.
deltas.reason: The project's explicit out-of-scope rationale rejects a duplicate verification mode.
deltas.tradeoff: No separate command surface or rigid schema checker is introduced.

deltas.change: Omit Claude-only disable-model-invocation frontmatter while copying agents/openai.yaml explicit-only policy.
deltas.reason: The target is Codex packaging; its metadata preserves invocation intent and the bundled validator accepts the supported frontmatter.
deltas.tradeoff: This package is not a byte-identical Claude entrypoint.

deltas.change: Make existing tracker conventions override the example seed in both entrypoint and support file.
deltas.reason: The first response trial invented an uninspected layout despite a preservation instruction.
deltas.tradeoff: Missing schema details remain explicit until inspected; a seed cannot fill them in as facts.
